_texte.Accesezi „Devino Partener\" din meniu, c: Open “Become a Partner" from the menu, fill in the form with your company's or sole trader's details, upload the documents requested (tax ID, licences, insurance) and send the request. The My Darrin team reviews the file and activates your account within 24–48h.
_texte.Ai alte întrebări? Echipa My Darrin îți: Any other questions? The My Darrin team will answer.
_texte.Ce se întâmplă dacă clientul nu confirmă: What happens if the customer doesn't confirm?
_texte.Ce tipuri de parteneri acceptați?: What types of partners do you accept?
_texte.Comisionul My Darrin variază în funcție: The My Darrin commission varies by service category and monthly order volume. The exact details are given at registration and in the partnership contract. There are no hidden costs or activation fees.
_texte.CUI/CIF, certificat de înregistrare, aut: Tax ID, registration certificate, relevant professional licences (e.g. ANRE certificate for electricians, ANRGN for gas fitters), motor insurance if you use a vehicle, professional liability insurance. The exact documents vary by service category.
_texte.Cum devin partener pe My Darrin?: How do I become a partner on My Darrin?
_texte.Cum funcționează documentarea before/aft: How does the before/after documentation work?
_texte.Cum primesc o comandă?: How do I receive an order?
_texte.Cum semnez PV-ul digital?: How do I sign the digital report?
_texte.Când primesc plata pentru o comandă?: When do I get paid for an order?
_texte.Cât este comisionul platformei?: How much is the platform commission?
_texte.Da, o poți declina din aplicație. Refuzu: Yes, you can decline it in the app. Repeated refusals without a valid reason affect your allocation score. If you're unavailable, you set your status to “Unavailable" in the app and you won't receive orders during that period.
_texte.Da. Ca furnizor de materiale îți listezi: Yes. As a materials supplier you list your products in the My Darrin marketplace. Customers can order them directly or add them to a service. Delivery is handled by the Neighbourhood Couriers.
_texte.Da. Ca operator de închirieri îți listez: Yes. As a rental operator you list your machinery, tools or equipment with a price per day/week/month. Bookings are made through the platform; delivery and collection are coordinated with the customer.
_texte.Da. My Darrin emite automat documentele: Yes. My Darrin automatically issues the tax documents required for each transaction. You'll find them in your partner portal → “Financial documents".
_texte.Da. În profilul tău declari raza de acop: Yes. In your profile you declare your coverage radius — you can select several counties or cities. My Darrin allocates orders according to your availability and coverage area.
_texte.Dacă clientul nu confirmă în 48h de la f: If the customer doesn't confirm within 48h of the completion you declared, the system confirms the work automatically and processes the payment, provided the before/after documentation is complete and correct.
_texte.Există o perioadă minimă de închiriere?: Is there a minimum rental period?
_texte.La finalul lucrării, din aplicație, sele: At the end of the job, in the app, you select “Complete the work" and sign the digital report. The customer is notified to confirm in turn. Both signatures are time-stamped and stored permanently.
_texte.La ridicarea echipamentului și la return: Mandatory condition photos are taken when the equipment is collected and returned. Any damage is recorded and settled automatically from the customer's deposit or through the insurance policy.
_texte.La sosire fotografiezi zona de lucru — s: On arrival you photograph the work area — the system archives the images automatically with a timestamp and GPS coordinates. At the end you photograph it again. These images are the basis of the digital report and of any complaint.
_texte.My Darrin alocă automat comanda unui par: My Darrin automatically allocates the order to an available partner in the order's area. You receive an email with the service, date, time slot and locality, and the order appears in your dashboard, under Tasks.
_texte.Parteneri de servicii (prestatori), furn: Service partners (providers), materials suppliers, rental operators, neighbourhood couriers and insurers. An account can hold several roles at the same time.
_texte.Perioada minimă și condițiile de închiri: You set the minimum period and the rental conditions in the equipment profile. My Darrin doesn't impose a standard minimum — you decide your commercial policy.
_texte.Plata este procesată după ce clientul co: Payment is processed after the customer confirms completion and signs the report. The transfer reaches your account within 24–48 working hours of confirmation.
_texte.Platforma gestionează comunicarea. Prime: The platform manages the communication. You automatically receive any change or adjustment the customer requests through the system. The Neighbourhood Courier is the exception — the customer can contact them directly about delivery details.
_texte.Pot activa în mai multe orașe?: Can I work in several cities?
_texte.Pot comunica cu clientul?: Can I communicate with the customer?
_texte.Pot vinde materiale pe My Darrin?: Can I sell materials on My Darrin?
_texte.Pot închiria echipamente prin platformă?: Can I rent out equipment through the platform?
_texte.Primele 3 comenzi sunt monitorizate mai: The first 3 orders are monitored more closely by the My Darrin team. If the average rating is ≥4.5★, the account automatically moves to “Verified partner" status with access to more orders.
_texte.Primesc factură de la My Darrin?: Do I get an invoice from My Darrin?
